## ba5056d6102e

**No issue found in the checked scope.** Generator SHA-256
`96571a5f2bca605f2412422fabb268ee84246d0dc1e789d30d58945a1bb92b6c`,
rule hash `1586ec3843ec`.

I checked the current source rather than relying on its prior notes. The portable
task-test stage passed 37/37, and rule smoke passed. Its retained Racket-backed
probe materialized 100 three-demo/one-query lessons in each of easy, medium, and
hard: 300/300 were identifiable, with 1,200 generated pairs and 1,023 exact-byte
unique inputs/pairs. The probe dynamically used the generator's declared
competitors and canonical shortcuts. Evidence:
`checks/audit/ba5056d6102e/lesson-probe.json`,
`checks/audit/ba5056d6102e/task-tests/`, and
`checks/audit/ba5056d6102e/rule-smoke/`.

I specifically revisited equal panel colors because that relation was defective
in the selected task. Here, distinct top and bottom colors are explicitly part
of the summary, invariants, axis contract, incompatibility declarations, and
role grammar. I therefore treat equal colors as a documented domain exclusion,
not an untested lawful case. This audit is finite and does not prove absence of
all unknown shortcuts. No files for this audit target were changed.
